profile.headline: Software architect, middle blocker, dad
profile.summary:
I have two decades of experience designing and building software solutions that scale to the needs of the business.  I am an advocate and mentor for agile processes, aggressive testing and the long term maintenance of a healthy code base.

I enjoy projects that ship early and often and have a meaningful connection to the world around them and their users' lives.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Investment manager/investor relations, document signing and management.  Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, MongoDB/DocumentDB, Helm, Camunda, GraphQL.
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · PostgreSQL · Orchestration · Flask · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · Pyramid

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Engineering Manager
positions.description: Custom CMS and workflow solutions for commercial real estate brokers.  Traditional and serverless components.  Python, Django, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, Celery.  Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.
positions.insights: Skills: Django REST Framework · PostgreSQL · Elasticsearch · Django · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Architect
positions.description: Design and implement scalable and fault-tolerant transactional and asynchronous services.  Work heavily with Python, SQLAlchemy and MySQL.  Manage an AWS environment including Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, RDS, SQS, S3, Lambda, ElastiCache, Route 53.  Manage a Proxmox build cluster running Jenkins, corporate domain services.
